trailhead.label: The Rifugio Vederna (1,324 m), the APT’s start

cautions: Gravel forest road, shared with forestry vehicles.
A short grassy path to the cross.
An open viewpoint at the Croce degli Alpini.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The Rifugio Vederna (1,324 m), the APT’s: Il Rifugio Vederna (1.324 m), la partenza indicata dall'APT
textIt.Gravel forest road, shared with forestry: Strada forestale sterrata, percorsa anche da mezzi forestali.
Un breve sentiero erboso fino alla croce.
textIt.An open viewpoint at the Croce degli Alp: Un punto panoramico aperto alla Croce degli Alpini.
